subject: Re-starting MAP + evaluation playbook — CumulusPay (new champion)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@cumuluspay.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@cumuluspay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re-starting MAP + evaluation playbook — CumulusPay (new champion)

Hi Alice / Ben —

Congrats on the new internal lead — welcome Alice. Given the org change you flagged, I wanted to re-start the mutual action plan (MAP) with a condensed evaluation playbook so we can get a clean handoff and an accurate close timeline. I attached an editable MAP (CumulusPay_MAP_v2.pdf) and pasted the high-level plan below.

High-level MAP (proposed)
- Week 0: Introductions & kickoff (30 min) — confirm stakeholders, scope, acceptance criteria
- Week 1: Technical onboarding — test account, SSO + networking checklist, sample traffic
- Week 2: Evaluation run — cost/latency baselines, functional checks (chat, reranking)
- Week 3: Security review & SOC2 evidence (if required) + procurement paperwork
- Week 4: Decision & contract signature

Requests / asks for kickoff
1) Please confirm who will own the evaluation on your side (product, eng, compliance).
2) Share any hard constraints (PCI/PHI scope, blocked ports, SSO provider).
3) Two 30-min slots that work for a kickoff next week (I have May 12 or May 14 open).

Alice — quick intro copy for your new champion is fine; I can run a short walkthrough of the playbook and we’ll map internal owners. Grace and Vivek are cc'ed — Grace will own the success criteria and test plan; Vivek will handle the infra/SSO checklist.

Attachments: CumulusPay_MAP_v2.pdf (editable), MAP-test-plan.csv (skeleton)

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alice Chen <alice@cumuluspay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@cumuluspay.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@cumuluspay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-starting MAP + evaluation playbook — CumulusPay (new champion)

Jonas —

Thanks for the note and for the clear plan. I’m stepping in as the product champion for this initiative. A few quick items from our side:
- Ben will lead the engineering validation and run the evaluation tests.
- Maria Gomez (cc) is handling procurement — she’s the contact for contractual questions and NDAs.
- We need to confirm PCI scoping before the evaluation starts; that may adjust the test surface.

Kickoff windows: May 14 (anytime 10:00–14:00 PT) works best for us. If possible, can you include a short section in the MAP that calls out the PCI scoping checkpoint and who will sign off?

We’ll review the attached MAP and revert with stakeholders for specific test cases. Looking forward to getting momentum back on this.

Best,
Alice Chen
Senior Product Manager — Integrations
CumulusPay
+1 (212) 555-8801

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@cumuluspay.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@cumuluspay.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re-starting MAP + evaluation playbook — CumulusPay (new champion)

Jonas — quick technical notes to include before kickoff: 

- SSO: We support SAML and OIDC. If CumulusPay wants SSO during evaluation, please provide IdP metadata and a test user.
- Data retention: default logs retained 30 days; we can adjust retention policies if compliance requires shorter windows.
- Test cases: I expanded the MAP-test-plan.csv to include acceptance criteria for latency, token cost, and output quality (sample prompts attached in the CSV).
- PCI scoping: if they require token redaction or encryption at rest beyond our default, we’ll need their compliance contact to sign off on proposed changes.

I’ve attached MAP-test-plan.csv. Happy to join the kickoff for the technical 15–20 minute segment.

—Grace
Customer Success – Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Re-starting MAP + evaluation playbook — CumulusPay (new champion)

Thanks all — confirmed for kickoff: May 14 at 11:00 AM PT (30 min). Calendar invite to follow.

Updated next steps I’ll own: 
- By EOD May 12: I’ll share CumulusPay_MAP_v2.1.pdf with the PCI scoping checkpoint called out and a filled-in owner column.
- By EOD May 13: Ben to provide IdP metadata or confirm SSO not required for the evaluation; Maria to share procurement timeline/PO process.
- Week of May 18: Technical evaluation run (Grace/Vivek to coordinate with Ben).
